name: SpendKeep
tagline: The Privacy-First Expense Tracker. No Bank Login Required.
description: Track expenses without bank sync. AI categorization via email forwarding & CSV import. No PSpendKeep is a privacy-first AI finance tracker. It automatically categorizes expenses by parsing bank SMS and forwarded emails using LLMs—no Plaid or bank sync required. Beyond budgeting, it features an institutional-grade portfolio analyzer that calculates Sharpe ratios, risk volatility, and concentration, complete with personalized AI financial health verdicts.

name: Bill Rescue — Know What To Pay First
tagline: Stop guessing which bills to pay first, let the system do it
description: Overwhelmed by bills? Bill Rescue uses AI to build a personalized action plan that tells you what to pay, in what order, and how to negotiate — in minutes.

name: Divvy
tagline: Scan the bill. Split it by who had what.
description: Divvy helps groups split any food bill based on what each person had. Scan the receipt, assign the items, and it works out shared dishes, uneven portions, tax, tip, and service charges. It also checks the numbers against the final total and produces a clear breakdown to share. No account or download required.

name: Frugal Funds
tagline: Helps you to save your money on a daily basis
description: A beautifully simple daily budget tool. Set your budget, track expenses, and roll over savings, all stored privately on your device. No accounts, no hassle. Start coontrolling your spendings today.

name: BudgetFlow
tagline: Personal budget and Finance tool
description: BudgetFlow is a clean, personal budget and finance app with no subscriptions and no bank logins. Track your spending, plan ahead, and reach your goals on any device. This personal budget and finance app allows you to analyse your spending habits and make informed decisions. Utilising a personal budget and finance tool can lead to better savings and investments in the long run.

name: Spendsy
tagline: The easiest way to track money with buckets
description: Spendsy helps you organize spending with simple buckets, track expenses across accounts, and stay in control. Built for people who want clarity without the complexity of traditional budgeting apps.

name: Jelas
tagline: Akhirnya jelas, duitmu ke mana.
description: Jelas adalah aplikasi catat pengeluaran AI untuk orang Indonesia. Catat dengan bahasa biasa, AI yang merapikan, dan dapatkan insight yang bisa dipakai.

name: Finalyse.ai
tagline: Your ai assisted budget tracker
description: Finalyse.ai is an iOS personal finance app for tracking spending, budgets, recurring dues, loans, credit cards, savings goals, and AI-guided financial reviews.

name: Halcón
tagline: Private expense tracker. Upload statements, no bank sync
description: Halcón turns CSV, Excel and AEB43 bank statements into categorized transactions and a spending dashboard. No bank sync or banking credentials. EU-hosted, with a 30-day free trial and no card required.

name: Spendly
tagline: Budgeting, without the spreadsheet
description: I kept spending money and could never recall what I'd spent it on. By month's end, my budget was gone with nothing to show for where. So I built Spendly, a simple budgeting assistant that works entirely inside Telegram. No extra app, no setup. Just message it whenever you spend, and it logs the expense and keeps your budget in check. Now in BETA, I'd love for you to try it. 👇

name: Zero: Budget with Zero
tagline: Local-first zero-based budgeting, no bank connection
description: Zero is a local-first, zero-based budgeting app for people who prefer not to connect their bank. Core budgeting screens read from an on-device database for immediate interactions, while confirmed changes sync across your devices. It is local-first, not offline-only: saving pauses while fully disconnected. Enter transactions manually or import from YNAB, Actual Budget, or CSV. Use targets, schedules, spending, and net-worth insights. Try every feature free for 34 days—no card required.

name: Wallop
tagline: Budgeting with a pig who guilt-trips you into saving
description: Every budgeting app tells you the numbers. Wallop makes you care about them - a pig mascot who reacts to every deposit and every withdrawal, so your emergency fund stops being an abstract balance and starts being something you don't want to let down. Weirdly, that's what makes people actually stick to their goals.

name: Money Plann
tagline: 🚀 Money Plann is live — free AI budgeting, no catch.
description: Unlike YNAB or Mint, Money Plann is completely free — no subscriptions, no paywalls, no premium tiers. What makes it different is the built-in AI chat: instead of digging through charts, you simply ask your finances questions in plain language, like 'How much did I spend on food this month?' It combines expense, income, and budget tracking in one place, with an AI assistant that actually understands your data. Simpler, smarter, and free — budgeting without the complexity or the price tag.

name: Spend.Report
tagline: See what you're spending money each month
description: Upload a bank or credit card statement, get one page: where the money went, what repeats, and how to cancel it. Free, no signup, no bank login.

name: FreedomPlan
tagline: Know Your Exact Debt-Free Date
description: Take control of your money with this printable and digital budget planner. Track expenses, calculate debt payoff, plan savings, and know your projected debt-free date. What it does: 🎯 Your exact Debt Freedom Date ❄️⛄ Snowball vs Avalanche comparison 💰 Budget tracker 📊 Interest saved calculator 💪 Extra payment simulator Two modes in one tool — budget tracking and debt payoff — both auto-saving to your browser as you go. No login. No subscription. HTML tool opens in any browser.

name: Cadence Money
tagline: Budget & net worth tracking in a simple, smart, private way.
description: Cadence Money is a simple, smart, privacy-focused budget and net worth tracking app that lets you pay for exactly what you need and nothing you don't. Made in Canada by a 1Password builder for Canadians and Americans. Track your budget, net worth, goals, income, bills, and holdings. Get insights, suggestions and historical reports on spending, budget adherence, gains and more. Available across iOS, Android, and web.

name: Tally
tagline: Free personal finance calculators — real math, no sign-up
description: Tally is a set of free, no-signup personal finance calculators — budget, debt payoff, emergency fund, savings goal, compound interest, home affordability, true hourly rate — paired with plain-spoken articles that show the actual math behind each one. No ads gating the tools, no email wall. Just type your numbers and see the result instantly.

name: MizuFlow
tagline: Budget your income into custom categories.
description: MizuFlow can detect your income source(s) and allow the user to distribute it into custom budget categories. Subscriptions & bills are tracked, alerting the user for upcoming prices or price changes. Net worth is analyzed throughout the user's transactions, giving a fully fleshed out history of the user's growth. Our UI feels clean and comfortable to navigate through, heavily emphasizing on intuition and intention.

name: Finance Register
tagline: Personal finance management, built for your Mac
description: Finance Register is a local-first Mac app for accounts, transactions, scheduled bills and income, budgets, reports, and planning.

name: Bill Split Pro
tagline: Track & Divide Group Expenses
description: Bill Split Pro is a free bill splitting app for Android, iOS, and the web. Create a group, share one link and password, and start adding expenses together without registration. Track and divide group expenses, calculate who owes what, upload receipts with AI, import bank statements, export reports, chat with your group, and settle balances with the fewest payments possible.

name: Migma AI
tagline: AI runs your email marketing. Better with every send.
description: Migma creates full campaigns before you ask. It understands your goals and events, creates every email, personalizes and localizes it, and renders consistently across inboxes. It handles sending, preferences and compliance, then learns what drives revenue.

name: NudgeForMe
tagline: AI follow-up agent for missed email opportunities
description: NudgeForMe scans your sent conversations, finds threads where someone never replied, and drafts natural follow-ups inside your own mailbox. It starts in draft mode, so you stay in control. You can review each opportunity, select the useful ones, and send from Gmail, Outlook, or IMAP/SMTP. Built by the Snoooz team after processing millions of emails, NudgeForMe is focused on one painful workflow: making sure leads, deals, partnerships, and customer conversations do not quietly go cold.

name: Timely
tagline: Pull your calendar availability in 3 seconds
description: Pull your availability from connected calendars, with a single keystroke, within whichever timezone suits your recipient best. No opening the calendar, no timezone maths, and it handles multiple execs too. It's completely private and sits locally on your machine, connecting only to Outlook and Google.

name: Flodesk Studio
tagline: A place to make beautiful emails.
description: Describe it, and Flodesk Studio designs a beautifully on-brand email in seconds. Built by top designers, accelerated by AI, finished by you. Free in beta.

name: PureBox.ai
tagline: Review-first AI cleanup for your real Gmail inbox.
description: Most inbox tools make you build rules first. PureBox skips that - it's personalized from your first scan using AI and your own Gmail history (which senders you open, reply to, or let pile up), so suggestions fit your routine on day one. Every suggestion shows why, and nothing moves until you approve - no black box, no silent deletions. It surfaces what needs your attention, not just what to trash. Your data is never sold; Pro subscriptions fund it.

name: Customer.io Summer Release
tagline: New ways to reach customers in the moments that matter
description: Customer.io's most expansive launch yet brings powerful new ways to engage customers exactly when it matters across expanded triggers, surfaces, and channels. Reach customers with geofencing, Live Notifications, flexible SMS providers, notification inbox, and beyond. Improved WhatsApp management, smarter AI, and more, all from one platform.

name: Skim
tagline: Free, open-source AI email client for Windows
description: Skim is a free, open-source (MIT) email client for Windows. ✂️ Minimal on purpose: no calendar, no rules engine, no bloat. Fewer buttons, less cognitive load. ⚡ Native Rust core (Tauri 2): ~5 MB installer, sub-second cold start, instant full-text search. 🔒 Local-first, offline-ready, zero telemetry. ✦ AI on your terms: bring your own Anthropic or OpenRouter key and Skim drafts replies in your voice and answers questions across your whole mailbox.

name: Memo
tagline: Turn one idea into an email worth remembering.
description: Most email tools help you send. Memo helps you matter.

name: GreenmorMail
tagline: One inbox. Outreach, team chat, AI, and video — built in.
description: Business email hosting at $1/mailbox/month — with outreach sequences, in-thread team chat, video conferencing, an AI assistant, Drive, and Calendar built in. No ads. No data mining. Powered by AWS SES. Set up in under 10 minutes.

name: ForthWrite
tagline: AI email writer that actually sounds like you.
description: ForthWrite drafts replies in your voice inside Gmail, Outlook, and LinkedIn. Every edit becomes a training signal, so drafts get closer to how you write over time. Standouts: closed-loop voice matching, a visible improvement curve, ability to hit "Generate draft" in any thread, plus Pro auto-draft, batch, and Prompt Lab. BYOK on paid plans (9 providers). Free: 10 drafts/week, no card, no API key. 14-day Pro trial included.
topics: Chrome Extensions, Email, Productivity, Artificial Intelligence

name: Email Finder by Truelist

name: Engine Mail

description: Engine Mail is a private, AI-powered email workspace for every inbox. Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo or any IMAP email account in one unified inbox. Block trackers, detect phishing, deep-scan suspicious links and attachments, screen unknown senders, unsubscribe in one click, automate cleanup, work offline, track real engagement and collaborate securely.

name: Postfleet
tagline: Prompt-injection-safe email for AI agents
description: AI agents are getting email but raw inboxes are an attack surface: prompt injection, spam, malicious files. Postfleet is email infrastructure for agents. Every inbound message is verified, spam/virus-screened, and checked for prompt injection before your agent reads it, then delivered already parsed and comprehended. Outbound is idempotent with optional human approval. 6 MCP tools + a REST API. Would love your feedback!

No Docker. No VPS. No monthly bill. Just deploy and own your email privacy forever.

Generate images without leaving the chat. Run design "skills" on any section to push the agent past generic filler toward sharper layout. Export your code as a zip. You own what you build.

name: LayerProof Mylar
tagline: Create launch-ready motion videos for your products
description: LayerProof Motion's AI agent turns a product page, doc, or prompt into a full motion video - script, scenes, and voiceover included. Regenerate any scene, refine every keyframe, and export for multiple channels. Launch-ready product video in minutes.

name: Firstpass
tagline: Actionable input so you nail every launch
description: If you've ever shipped a launch and watched your copy get truncated, ignored, or misread — Firstpass shows you every surface a stranger meets your product on (the Product Hunt page, the leaderboard row, the Glaze Store grid) and pins handwritten crit notes to what breaks in each one, before you publish. The same tagline lives or dies differently depending on where it lands: PH gives you 60 characters, the Glaze Store caps at 40, the browse grid cuts near 33. Nobody checks — until it's live.

name: Brandfetch MCP
tagline: Stop your AI from guessing brand logos

Try it in Claude: https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/brandfetch Or use it from any MCP client: https://mcp.brandfetch.io/mcp

No setup, no risk to production. Explore ideas side by side as a team. Like where two variants are headed? Drag one into the other to merge them. When an idea is ready, open a PR straight to GitHub. Every prompt is recorded, so reviewers see exactly how it was built and a live link lets anyone test before a single line hits main.

Viewer-side AI-enabled Q&A and analytics come built in.

AI understands the context behind your activity, separates focus from distraction, visualizes your daily workflow, and helps you understand your attention patterns. Need a little help staying focused? Drifty detects sustained distractions and gently nudges you back to work. Runs locally for privacy, with the option to use the cloud when you want.

tagline: Replace mindless scrolling with tiny real-life wins
description: We all have spare minutes we usually spend scrolling. Just Minutes helps you turn them into small wins with quick, randomized activities. Build momentum one tiny action at a time instead of reaching for social media.

name: My Todo 2.0
tagline: The Simplest way to stay focused
description: Manage tasks. Track time. All floating above everything you do. So you stay focused, and nothing gets lost.

name: Archon: Track & Stay Focused
tagline: Track Your time, build your flow
description: Honestly, most "time is money" apps just turn your spending into work hours. Mine flips it. Every waking minute is a coin, around 960 a day, and you either capture them by logging what you did or they're gone at midnight. Logging is the part everyone quits over, so it's voice first: say "deck for an hour, then gym" and it lands as a clean timeline. No screen time spying, no judgment. It just asks one question: can you account for your day?

name: Arcadia

description: Arcadia maps your to-do items onto a beautiful clock face. If you struggle with time blindness or get overwhelmed by text-heavy lists, this shows you instantly how much time you have left between tasks.

name: Velprium

description: Velprium is a digital bullet journal built on top of your Google Calendar. Keep your calendar exactly as it is Velprium adds status, tags, and ratings to your events, lets you see the same day through Plan / Act / Review lenses, and turns your history into weekly & monthly reports on where your time actually went. Unfinished plans aren't silently pushed forward: you migrate them intentionally, and the full trace is preserved. You can also ask AI to organize your schedule or analyze patterns

name: Cognis Flow
tagline: A 3-checkbox tracker for people whose focus keeps drifting
description: Most productivity systems fail because they're too big to survive a bad day. 5am wake-ups, 3hr deep work, journaling — great in theory, gone by day 4. The 30-Day Attention Reset strips it to 3 daily checkboxes: a Morning Anchor, One Deep Work Block, and a Nightly Shutdown. Miss a day? You don't restart the month, just pick the next box back up. Includes weekly reflection prompts and bonus productivity techniques. Print once, use for a month.

name: Spantail

description: Everything you need to know about your cap table lives somewhere: in your lawyer's head, in a paralegal's inbox, in a VC's mental model built over decades. Mantle Clerk puts that knowledge in your corner. Ask a question, drop in a document, describe what just closed, and Mantle Clerk answers, records, and drafts what comes next.

name: X Money
tagline: Your money, on the world's most powerful network.
description: One app, everything money can do: earn industry-leading APY, get cashback with the X Card, and send money instantly on X.

name: Finamie
tagline: Speak your expenses and get instant spending insights
description: Finamie turns your voice into detailed financial insights, automatically. Log expenses hands-free, track your spending, and understand your money like never before.

name: RightCard
tagline: The honest credit card picker — no bank login
description: RightCard tells you which of your cards to use at any store and auto-adds the bank offers you'd forget to activate (Amex, Chase, Citi, Wells Fargo). It keeps rotating 5% categories straight so you don't have to remember them, and warns you before card credits and annual fees renew. No bank login, no account, no tracking — the Safari extension reads the offers page you're already signed into, and recommendations are computed on your phone, even offline. Honest numbers only. Free, no ads.

name: UniwebPay Skill
tagline: Financial Infra for the AI era
description: Accept payments the moment you ship. UniwebPay Skill is the financial infrastructure for the AI era, helping builders turn AI products into businesses. Generate payment links, accept global payment methods, and start getting paid without the usual payment setup, merchant onboarding, or infrastructure overhead.

name: SyncStaq
tagline: Stripe billing data, always current in Google Sheets
description: SyncStaq syncs Stripe billing data into Google Sheets — charges, invoices, invoice line items, customers, subscriptions, payouts and disputes, each in its own structured tab. What's different: most exports and scripts pull by created date, so records that change later (refunds, subscription updates, disputes) quietly go stale. SyncStaq syncs from Stripe's event stream, so your sheet updates when the data changes. Read-only Stripe access. Hourly sync. 14-day free trial.

name: Rex
tagline: AI agents that run order-to-cash operations
description: Rex builds the AI order-to-cash workforce for global enterprises, with agents that cover every account and resolve exceptions before cash gets stuck.

name: Cardzen
tagline: Track every credit, perk, and point before it expires
description: The average premium cardholder leaves up to $1,500 in credits and points on the table every year. Cardzen tracks every credit, perk, and multiplier across your cards, reminds you before anything expires, and tells you which card to use for every purchase. Ask the AI advisor anything about your wallet, get a daily digest of what needs attention, and stop paying annual fees for benefits you never use.

name: Orite
tagline: Give your AI Agent money. Not a blank check.
description: AI agents can already shop, book, and research on their own but the moment one needs to pay, every existing system assumes a human clicks approve. Nobody built for agents. Orite fixes that. Set spending limits once Orite enforces them on every transaction, automatically. Stay within budget, it just happens. Go over, it's blocked or held for a quick yes/no. Every payment logged, always explainable. Works wherever you build your agent. This is day one of AI having its own money.

name: AngelList Link
tagline: MCP for GPs: turn your fund into something you can talk to
description: AngelList Link is an MCP server for GPs to turn your fund into something you can talk to. One source of truth. Verified answers. Daily financials. Queryable from Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI tool you already work from. Ask a question about your own fund — capital call status, LP holdings across vehicles, a valuation update — and get an answer instantly. This is agentic fund management: the system of record for more than 25,000 funds and SPVs, queryable from any AI tool.

name: WealthNest.ai
tagline: AI-powered personalized family office for your wealth
description: Your family's entire financial life — investments, insurance, tax, and inheritance — in one AI-powered dashboard. See everything in one place, get smart insights on risks and opportunities, and personalized advice on what to do next. Built for families.

name: LedgerPort
tagline: Automate Accounting For Multiple E-commerce Stores,Reliably
description: LedgerPort syncs Shopify and WooCommerce to QuickBooks Online — sales, fees, refunds, and taxes — and reconciles each payout to your bank deposit, splitting the net number back into its parts so the books match the bank. Built for US businesses: multi-store operators, and the CPAs and bookkeeping firms managing them, each with their own dashboard. Pricing is a fixed monthly slab based on your order volume, so you know the bill before it arrives. Summary or order-level sync, per store.

name: BeeL
tagline: Invoicing API
description: In Spain, every invoice now has to be tamper-proof and reported to the tax agency. That's Verifactu, and building it yourself eats a quarter of engineering time. BeeL is one API that just does it. Point us at your payments and each charge becomes a legal invoice, filed with the tax agency and emailed to your customer. One click on Stripe, no code — or wire the API into your product. REST, SDKs, and a CLI so Claude Code or any AI agent can invoice. Free sandbox, no limits.

name: Notwen
tagline: Get paid, track expenses, forecast income - on autopilot
description: Notwen gives freelancers and solopreneurs a single, honest view of earnings, tax reserves, and safe-to-spend cash. It turns invoices and expenses into real numbers while AI forecasts cash flow, flags late payments, and finds missed deductions. Create AI-drafted invoices and contracts, track time and tasks, and analyze client profitability with automated reminders and scheduling so you can focus on the work that matters.

name: BEXHUB
tagline: The professional network where expertise becomes capital
description: BEXHUB is a professional network where your skills have real spending power. Contribute your expertise, earn BEX, and use it to get the talent, services, and digital products your business needs. Prefer money? Get paid directly. Zero commission.

name: Defellix
tagline: Never lose a payment to a ghosting client again
description: Defellix helps freelancers in India create contracts that actually hold up if a client stops paying. No WhatsApp promises. Contracts are timestamped, blockchain-anchored, and court-admissible under Section 65B, created in about 2 minutes, client signs with just an OTP. Also included: auto-generated demand notices, milestone tracking, and MSME guidance for faster recovery. Early-stage team, building in the open. Would love your feedback.

name: Hey Noah
tagline: A proactive AI executive assistant for founders
description: Noah is a proactive AI executive assistant for founders. Claude talks to you; Noah talks to your network. It's like Tesla Full Self Driving, and not cruise control- an autonomous AI EA that manages your calendar, relationships, and follow-ups across email, text, and WhatsApp - so nothing slips. Think of it as an always-on EA living in your SMS and helping you with meeting logistics.
makers: ashish_toshniwal1, johnbeadle, danira_lujan, aditya_thaker28, akshath_mahajan, ryan_brandt, darcwader, atulpat3l, navinkishoreravikumar, ryan_brandt4

name: Hardbook
tagline: The freelancer booking link that signs the contract for you
description: The gap between agreed dates and a signed contract is where freelance jobs die. Hardbook fixes it. Your client picks dates and signs the contract in one flow. No app, no account, no chasing. Built by a freelancer to stop deal decay and lock in work.

name: radiusHQ
tagline: One link replaces your scheduling chaos
description: Your services, prices, calendar, payments, and reminders — all in one beautiful page. Clients book in 30 seconds. You set it up in 10 minutes.

name: MeetIsland
tagline: The Dynamic Island that gets you to meetings on time
description: MeetIsland turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island for meetings. Your next call lives quietly around the notch and expands with a live countdown and a one-click Join button (Meet/Zoom) right before it starts. Zero setup — it reads calendars already synced to macOS. $6.99 once, 14-day free trial.

name: birthdays.app
tagline: A text-based birthday reminder app, built for simplicity.
description: birthdays.app is a text-based birthday reminder app. • Birthday + early reminders via text message • Import birthdays from Google Calendar or Facebook • Add friends easily via text (“Joe Aug 8”) • Send a real card: choose your card, write your message, and we’ll mail it. Just because a calendar works doesn't mean it's the right tool. Texts are simpler and impossible to miss.

name: Milo is now on Android!
tagline: Plan life together, now on Android
description: Milo is a friendly agenda app for trips, birthdays, holidays, appointments, and everything in between. Create private or shared agendas, organize plans in one place, and keep everyone on the same page. Now available on Android—and designed and built with AI from idea to launch.

name: Routemize™
tagline: Route-Optimized Instant Bookings
description: Routemize is AI scheduling built for service businesses that live and die by their route. Customers self-book instantly into the exact slot that keeps your day tightest — no calls, no back-and-forth, no guesswork. Smart routing logic and instant booking mean only the right jobs land on your calendar, at the right time. Built by a home service founder who was tired of losing hours to windshield time. Route multiple salespeople to the right appointments based on territory and rules. Gamechanger!

name: Cal Clear
tagline: Scheduling that checks all your calendars. Zero tracking.
description: Cal Clear: free scheduling app that checks all your Google Calendars — no double booking, no tracking. Best free Calendly alternative 2026.

name: diVenuo
tagline: Booking software for barbers, tattooists and dog groomers
description: Most booking tools are one calendar with a different logo on top. diVenuo is built vertical by vertical. Tattoo studios get a body map, one code per tattoo across every session, and a quote before any calendar. Dog groomers get time that scales with the dog: same service, 80 min for a small one, 180 for a big one. Barbershops get a one-tap walk-in queue. Every shop gets its own page and brand, and deposits land straight in their own Mercado Pago, with no commission per booking.

name: Sessurely
tagline: Booking software that charges no-show fees for you
description: Appointment scheduling with built-in no-show protection. Take deposits, keep a card on file, and automatically charge no-show fees — built for coaches, trainers, consultants, and photographers.

name: Monthly Calendar
tagline: Plan your month with a clean calendar.
description: Stay organized every month with a printable calendar featuring spacious daily boxes for appointments, deadlines, events, reminders, and personal goals. Perfect for work, school, and home planning.

name: Daymo
tagline: Your week at a glance.
description: Daymo is a free and open source calendar app built to always show upcoming days with clear week markers. It makes it easy to get a feel for what's up next. It is meant to be used together with existing device calendars to keep compatibility and make it easier to get started.

name: Concairge
tagline: The World's First AI Family Assistant
description: The AI family assistant that brings every family member's calendar, reminders, and activity ideas into one shared view. Designed for the parent who coordinates it all.

name: ZugFlow
tagline: Salon management software with online booking
description: ZugFlow is an all-in-one management platform for hair salons, barbershops and beauty professionals. Manage appointments, clients, team schedules, online bookings, automated reminders, revenue and business reports from one simple dashboard. Every salon also gets its own online booking page. Start with a 30-day free trial, then €14.99/month with all features included.

name: Dailytine - Routine, To do, Memo
tagline: Manage your routines, to-dos, calendar in one simple app.
description: Dailytine is a lightweight daily planner that brings routines, to-dos, calendar events, and quick notes into one simple place. Instead of switching between multiple apps, you can see what matters today, check off recurring habits, organize tasks, capture notes, and track your progress over time. Built for anyone who wants a calmer, cleaner way to plan and record everyday life.

name: Slot'd
tagline: Create a Slot. Share it. Get Paid.
description: Slot'd helps service pros turn open time into shareable, claimable Slots. Create a Slot, share the link, and let clients book and pay online — booking page, calendar, CRM, and Stripe payments in one.
